releases.name: Mnemory 1.16.0
releases.body:
Adds opt-in verbatim assistant memories and stops generated date ranges from hiding memories in `find_memories`.

## Added

- `ALLOW_ASSISTANT_VERBATIM` (off by default) allows assistant-role memories to
  be stored with `infer=false` when `ALLOW_CLIENT_INFER` is also enabled. This
  increases the risk of persistent prompt injection: enable it only with
  authentication enforced and trusted clients on all memory-write paths.
- REST and MCP add-memory responses report the effective `infer` mode.

## Fixed

- A date range generated by `find_memories` now only adds candidates from that
  period instead of filtering out undated or out-of-range memories (#23).
- Unparseable generated date ranges are ignored instead of failing the search.

## Validation

Unit tests: 1,728 passed, 20 skipped. Ruff passed. Release E2E: 80 passed.
Python source and wheel distributions were built from the release commit and
reviewed.

The Cognis introduction and best-effort deletion warning are unchanged.

releases.name: Mnemory 1.15.3
releases.body:
Fixes OpenClaw plugin discovery and temporal memory recall.

## Fixed

- Declare plugin tools so OpenClaw can discover them.
- Document how to replace native memory tools with Mnemory.
- Verify the packaged plugin against supported OpenClaw versions.
- Correct event-date and creation-date filters, include undated memories where
  appropriate, and preserve date bounds in generated search queries.

## Validation

Unit tests: 1,655 passed, 20 skipped. Ruff, plugin packaging, Vitest and the
OpenClaw Gateway compatibility matrix passed. Release E2E was not run for this
release. Python source and wheel distributions were built and reviewed.

The Cognis introduction and best-effort deletion warning are unchanged.

releases.name: Mnemory 1.15.2
releases.body:
## Fixed

- Ship compiled JavaScript alongside the OpenClaw plugin sources, lock the build
  dependency, and verify that the packaged runtime loads before npm publication.

## Distribution

- Publish multi-architecture container images to
  `ghcr.io/fpytloun/mnemory`, with source-repository labels and tested tag rules.
- Document GHCR pull/build commands and retain the best-effort deletion warning
  alongside the Cognis introduction.

The OpenClaw plugin remains at its separately published version 0.2.2.
Deletion remains best effort, not a verified-erasure or compliance guarantee.

releases.name: OpenClaw Plugin v0.2.2
releases.body:
Fixes npm installation with recent OpenClaw versions by shipping compiled JavaScript.

Also fixes compatibility of the publishing verification with npm 12. See #16, #17, and #18.

releases.name: OpenClaw Plugin v0.2.1
releases.body:
The npm publication for this release failed; version 0.2.1 was not published to npm. Please use [OpenClaw Plugin v0.2.2](https://github.com/fpytloun/mnemory/releases/tag/openclaw-v0.2.2) instead.

The packaging fix and its follow-up are described in #16, #17, and #18.
